# AVERLI STUDIO

AVERLI is a creative studio connecting social media, Meta advertising and campaigns, SEO and digital marketing, and branding and graphic design through one considered approach.

## Services
- Social Media & Content: Posting is easy. Knowing what to say, why it matters and what comes next is where the work begins.
- Campaigns & Meta Advertising: More clicks are not always the answer. The focus is on the action that matters.
- SEO & Digital Marketing: Being online is one thing. Being found is another.
- Branding & Graphic Design: Identities and visual materials that work across digital, social and print.

## Selected work
- Gyalaktika Zagreb: A Meta advertising case file covering lead-generation creatives, campaign structure and optimisation.
- ACKitchen: A social media strategy and content-planning concept with audience segments, content roles, post concepts and a 12-post grid.
- Elysian Haven: Brand identity and visual direction, from logo and stationery to branded applications and social content.
- Vitality Bloom: Brand identity, packaging and landing-page design for a collagen powder product.
- Lastavica Cruising: Social content, route graphics, stories and a 12-post content plan for luxury yacht cruising on the Croatian Adriatic.
- Villa Unuk: A 23-page landscape sales brochure with editorial layout and redrawn floor plans for a residential development in Primošten, Croatia.
